name: Duplicate Line Remover
description: Remove duplicate lines from text while preserving the original order, with options for case sensitivity, whitespace trimming, and keeping the first or last occurrence.

faq.question: Does this sort or reorder my lines?
faq.answer: No — every remaining line keeps its original relative position. Only exact (or, with the whitespace/case options, near-exact) duplicate lines are removed.

faq.question: What's the difference between keeping the first vs. last occurrence?
faq.answer: Both preserve the original order of everything that survives — they only differ in which copy of a repeated line is the one that's kept. If a line's later version has more up-to-date content, "keep last" is usually what you want.
